dedupe_keys.name: geooutagekg multimodal geospatiotemporal knowledge graph of power outages in florida eagle i records night time lights outage maps

description: GeoOutageKG is a multimodal knowledge graph for power outage detection and analysis in Florida, described in a paper accepted to the ISWC 2025 resource track by researchers at the University of Central Florida. It aligns three sources with a purpose-built ontology, GeoOutageOnto: county-level outage records from the EAGLE-I dataset, NASA Black Marble night-time light images, and high-resolution outage maps generated with a multimodal outage prediction model. The paper reports over 10.6 million outage records from 2014 to 2024, 300,000 night-time light images from 2012 to 2024 and 15,000 outage maps, and shows uses in outage severity evaluation, energy access disparity analysis and grid operation support. The GitHub repository provides Python code to download Black Marble data with a NASA Earthdata token, convert it to county images and generate the graph in a chosen RDF format for a SPARQL endpoint, while the image and map archives are available for free download from the OSF project, which is licensed CC BY 4.0 and was modified in August 2026. Coverage is Florida. Caveats: the outage maps are model outputs, and regenerating imagery needs an Earthdata account. Simulation uses are linked outage, light and map data for hurricane outage analysis and restoration studies. Related records: data-eagle-i-recorded-electricity-outages-us-counties is the outage record source.
